ambiguities.source_text: Rank the students by the percentage of days they were "very late" (more than 5 minutes) during the year
ambiguities.intent: Denominator is present records, excluding absent rows. Very late is strictly more than 300 seconds.
Round each weekday mean to whole seconds, then clamp a negative mean to zero for output 1.

ambiguities.source_text: Turn the Scheduled Start Time and Arrival Time fields into Date Time fields
ambiguities.intent: Combine Date with scheduled and arrival clock times before subtraction.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate how many minutes late each student is each day
ambiguities.intent: Use signed total elapsed seconds, retaining early negative arrivals in the average.
Rank students by rounded percentage descending, then Student ID ascending.
ambiguities.ref: per_student = per_student.sort_values(["% Days Very Late", "Student ID"], ascending=[False, True])
